title: writing-for-agents.md places the one handover under docs/; it is dev/programme/HANDOVER.md
claim: writing-for-agents.md says tests/entities.py enforces 'exactly one handover under docs/'; closure.is_handover finds 0 handovers under docs/ and entities.py requires the one handover to be dev/programme/HANDOVER.md.
mechanism: The handover moved from docs/ to dev/programme/; closure.HANDOVER_DIRS and entities.py's check followed (both directories count, the living file must be dev/programme/HANDOVER.md), the rule's enforcement sentence did not.

evidence.contention_note: shared box, other finder seats running; a count is contention-immune

metric_definition: count of baseline tracked files under docs/ for which closure.is_handover is true
phenomenon_property: A rule's statement of what a check enforces matches the check's own predicate and expected value.
proposed_fix_scope: Edit the enforcement sentence of dev/governance/rules/writing-for-agents.md: exactly one handover, dev/programme/HANDOVER.md, a second under dev/programme/ or docs/ refused; rules_sync.mjs.
